reviews.title: SERIOUS WARNING: £32.66 EVERY WEEK AND NO ACCESS TO CONTENT
reviews.text:
Think very carefully before giving ReelShort your payment details.

I am being charged £32.66 every week for a subscription I cannot access and have repeatedly attempted to cancel.

I have contacted ReelShort numerous times, providing screenshots of my bank transactions, account information and all the evidence requested by their customer service team. Despite my repeated efforts, the charges continue.

Even my bank has attempted to stop the recurring payments, yet ReelShort continues to take money from my account. My bank has now issued a formal complaint response, confirming that attempts have been made to stop these payments. Today, another £32.66 has been taken.

That amounts to approximately £1,698 per year if these weekly charges continue, for a service I cannot even access.

How can a company continue charging a customer who has repeatedly requested cancellation, provided extensive evidence and made it clear that they no longer authorise these payments?

This situation is financially distressing, completely unacceptable and deeply concerning.

I strongly advise anyone considering subscribing to ReelShort to think twice. Ask yourself what will happen if you decide to cancel and find yourself in the same situation.

I will be escalating this matter to the Financial Ombudsman Service.

If I could give zero stars, I would.

I will continue updating this review every time another payment is taken until ReelShort resolves this matter, cancels the recurring payment authority
